source:
@@U04394@@
There they are, the same dark, ancient lindens,
strong and sturdy as ever.
And to think I’ve found them again
after all these years of wandering!
The same old place,
the same old cottage where they took me in
and tended my needs when tossed ashore on those
sandy dunes by stormy waves!
How I long to thank that brave, dear couple
that came to my aid.
But they were old even then.
I wonder if they’re still here to welcome me now?
What pious people they were!
Shall I knock?
Shall I call?
Greetings to you in there if you're still here,
still eager to find pleasure in doing good!

@@U04396@@
(A little, very old woman.)

@@U04397@@
Dear stranger! Gently! Gently!
He’s sleeping, my husband.
Softly!
Let him sleep.
He needs long rest
for the short time he’s awake.

@@U04399@@
Is it really you, then, Mother?
You, here, to receive my thanks,
you and your ancient husband,
who saved my young life so long ago?
translation:
@@U04394@@
它们就在那儿，同样黑暗、古老的椴树，
一如既往的坚强和坚固。
想到我又找到了他们
经过这么多年的流浪！
同样的老地方，
他们带我住的那间旧小屋
当我被扔到岸上时满足我的需要
暴风雨中的沙丘！
我多么渴望感谢那对勇敢、亲爱的夫妇
这对我有帮助。
但即使那时他们也已经老了。
我不知道他们现在还在这里欢迎我吗？
他们是多么虔诚的人啊！
我要敲门吗？
我要打电话吗？
如果你还在这里的话，向你问好
仍然渴望从行善中找到乐趣！

@@U04396@@
（一个身材矮小、年纪很大的女人。）

@@U04397@@
亲爱的陌生人！轻轻地！轻轻地！
他正在睡觉，我的丈夫。
轻轻！
让他睡吧。
他需要长时间的休息
他清醒的时间很短。

@@U04399@@
那么，妈妈，真的是你吗？
你在这里接受我的感谢，
你和你古老的丈夫，
这么久以前，是谁拯救了我年轻的生命？
